summary: Per-index field setter on a float-array object. First delegates to HUDElementConfig(this, a2, a3, a4, a5), then flags the element indexed by a2 as configured by writing 1 to byte this[8*a2+49], and finally copies a 3-float block from a6 into this[8*a2+50..52]. Returns a pointer to that copied 3-float slot.

operations.description: Delegate to HUDElementConfig(this, a2, a3, a4, a5) to configure the element.
Set the element's configuration flag byte this[8*a2+49] to 1.
Compute the slot pointer as &this[8*a2+50], the element's 3-float payload start.
Copy the 3 floats a6[0], a6[1], a6[2] into result[0], result[1], result[2].
Return the pointer to the copied 3-float slot.
